articles.title: SiriusPoint Appoints Rachel Winoski as Chief Human Resources Officer

articles.summary: SiriusPoint has today announced a new strategic partnership with Sutton Special Risk. Together, they have launched SportsSecure™, a specialized insurance solution designed to help college and university athletic programs manage injury-related financial exposures associated with Name, Image, Likeness (NIL) and revenue-sharing commitments.
